biggest_catch: The seller side is fee-free — the platform's mandatory fee is paid by the buyer at checkout (currently called the Buyer Protection fee, being renamed to a 'Vinted fee' in October 2026 terms).
catches: Sellers pay $0: no listing fee, no commission, no final-value fee — you keep 100% of the listed price.
Buyers pay a mandatory fee at checkout (Buyer Protection fee, ~3-8% per 2026 guides; exact figure from Vinted's fee help article).
October 2026 terms rename the buyer charge to a mandatory 'Vinted fee' and restate refund rights under a separate Refund Policy (lost, damaged, significantly not as described, counterfeit).
Vinted's US launch was January 2026 — the US audience is smaller than Europe's.
Shipping instructions are set after the sale; follow the method in the order instructions.

eligibility: US/UK/EU sellers; secondhand clothing, shoes, accessories, homeware
maximize: Vinted is the single highest-net-payout platform for used clothing: you keep the entire list price, so it beats Mercari (10%), Poshmark (20%), and eBay on identical items. Because the buyer pays the fee on top of your price, price at or slightly below your other-platform prices to stay competitive at checkout. List casually and often — with zero fees, even a $5 item is worth listing here. Never pay for optional listing boosts until you've proven what sells organically.

steps: List secondhand clothing, shoes, accessories, or homeware with photos and price (free)
Buyers purchase — they pay the mandatory buyer protection/Vinted fee on top of your price
Ship the item per the order's shipping instructions
Withdraw per the app's payout terms
timing: Payout per app terms; buyers have a short window to report issues
who_pays: The buyer pays through Vinted, and Vinted releases 100% of your list price to you.
who_qualifies: US, UK, and EU sellers of secondhand clothing, shoes, accessories, and homeware.
work_available: Vinted is active and open to new sellers — Vinted's US launch was January 2026, so the US audience is smaller than Europe's.
what_gets_accepted: Legal secondhand items are accepted; buyers have a short window after delivery to report issues (lost, damaged, significantly not as described, counterfeit).
costs_and_unpaid_time: Sellers pay $0 — no listing fee, no commission, no final-value fee; you keep 100% of the listed price. Buyers pay a mandatory fee at checkout (~3–8%). Unpaid time goes to photos, listing, and following the shipping method in the order instructions.
when_cash_arrives: After the buyer receives the item and confirms 'Everything is OK' (or the sale auto-completes after two business days), funds land in your Vinted Balance within two working days; withdrawing to your bank account can take up to 5 business days.
